segments.text: Remember the home button on the iPhone 7?
segments.say: Remember the home button on the iPhone seven?

segments.text: It came from the Taptic Engine:
a little weight, pushed back and forth by a magnet and a coil.
Precise enough to fool your finger.
Many cheap phones use a tiny spinning motor instead.
It buzzes like an angry bee.
faking keyboard clicks and scrolling ticks.
since 2016, your phone has been lying to your finger.
segments.say: since twenty sixteen, your phone has been lying to your finger.
